posts.title: Alkalinity Boost Changes Algae Growth and Lipids
posts.dek: A 16‑day study shows that raising seawater alkalinity alters Isochrysis galbana’s growth, stress enzymes, and lipid metabolism, indicating a shift from growth to defense.

posts.title: Bubbleless CO₂ membrane aeration boosts algae growth and nutrient removal from urine
posts.dek: Delivering CO₂ through a membrane raises Chlorella vulgaris biomass and sharply improves nitrogen and phosphorus capture from source‑separated urine.

posts.title: Copepod Diets Reveal Dinoflagellate Dominance in Subarctic Pacific
posts.dek: Isotope analysis shows Calanus spp. rely heavily on dinoflagellates in the Bering Strait, while tropical diets include more nitrogen‑fixers and bacteria.

posts.title: Nannochloropsis strains produce high‑quality biodiesel
posts.dek: Three Nannochloropsis species were grown under nitrogen‑starved, high‑light conditions, yielding up to 143 mg L⁻¹ day⁻¹ lipid and >98% conversion to biodiesel that meets ASTM and EN standards.

posts.title: Plasma‑treated chitosan dressing powers algae to heal diabetic wounds
posts.dek: A cold atmospheric plasma‑modified chitosan matrix couples red‑light‑activated microalgae to boost oxygen and energy production, speeding closure of diabetic skin wounds.

posts.title: Humic acids and salts reshape nanoplastic toxicity to algae
posts.dek: Combined humic acid and cations alter nanoplastic aggregation, bioaccessibility, and toxicity pathways in Chlorella vulgaris.

posts.title: Photosynthetic Biofilm Carriers Boost Wastewater Treatment and Biomass Yield
posts.dek: A systematic review finds that carrier type matters less than operating conditions for efficient nutrient removal and algae biomass production.
